expressions.title: The Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962
expressions.title_basis: p1 (Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, October 22, 1962; masthead blocks 2010116-2010125) blocks 2010126-2010130 print 'No. F. 32 (1)/62-Pub. ... ORDINANCE No. LXXVII OF 1962 AN ORDINANCE to amend the Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel Order, 1960'; s.1(1) names it the Deputy Attorney-General and Standing Counsel (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962; it ends on p2 at s.3 and the signatures 'MOHAMMAD AYUB KHAN ... President' / 'ABDUL HAMID, Secretary' (block 2010152). Blocks 2010153-2010165 (p2) are the head of ORDINANCE No. LXXVIII of 1962 (Military Court Sentences (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1962) cut off at s.1(1) at the end of this PDF -- a fragment, set aside as apparatus; that Ordinance is printed complete in document 5702 (owner policy q1 'split').
